annotations.title: Add a photo from a link

description: Adds a photo to a unit, or to the venue itself when unit_id is left out. Give the direct public https link to an existing photo file (jpg, png or webp, up to 15 MB): it is downloaded, resized and stored. The first photo of a group is its cover. Up to 16 per unit and for the venue. It stores existing photos only; it does not create images. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

image_url.description: Direct link to the photo file.

unit_id.description: Leave out for a photo of the venue as a whole.
